associations.rationale: The displayed declaration constructs a character-valued linear map on the quotient by the commutator submodule, providing the ambient dual-space construction but not the basis assertion.

The displayed theorem gives the spanning ingredient: every functional satisfying f(ab) = f(ba) lies in the span of the irreducible characters; it does not by itself state that those characters form a basis of the quotient dual.
The displayed theorem states linear independence of characters of pairwise nonisomorphic simple modules, which is one ingredient of the asserted basis result rather than the whole basis statement.
